Factorio, by Wube, is a game in which you build and maintain factories. You will be mining resources, researching technologies, building infrastructure, automating production and fighting enemies. In the beginning you will find yourself chopping trees, mining ores and crafting mechanical arms and transport belts by hand, but in short time you can become an industrial powerhouse, with huge solar fields, oil refining and cracking, manufacture and deployment of construction and logistic robots, all for your resource needs. However this heavy exploitation of the planet's resources does not sit nicely with the locals, so you will have to be prepared to defend yourself and your machine empire. Join forces with other players in cooperative Multiplayer, create huge factories, collaborate and delegate tasks between you and your friends. Add mods to increase your enjoyment, from small tweak and helper mods to complete game overhauls, Factorio's ground-up Modding support has allowed content creators from around the world to design interesting and innovative features. While the core gameplay is in the form of the freeplay scenario, there are a range of interesting challenges in the form of the Scenario pack, available as free DLC. If you don't find any maps or scenarios you enjoy, you can create your own with the in-game Map Editor, place down entities, enemies, and terrain in any way you like, and even add your own custom script to make for interesting gameplay. Factorio, by Wube, is a game in which you build and maintain factories. You will be mining resources, researching technologies, building infrastructure, automating production and fighting enemies. In the beginning you will find yourself chopping trees, mining ores and crafting mechanical arms and transport belts by hand, but in short time you can become an industrial powerhouse, with huge solar fields, oil refining and cracking, manufacture and deployment of construction and logistic robots, all for your resource needs. However this heavy exploitation of the planet's resources does not sit nicely with the locals, so you will have to be prepared to defend yourself and your machine empire. Join forces with other players in cooperative Multiplayer, create huge factories, collaborate and delegate tasks between you and your friends. Add mods to increase your enjoyment, from small tweak and helper mods to complete game overhauls, Factorio's ground-up Modding support has allowed content creators from around the world to design interesting and innovative features. While the core gameplay is in the form of the freeplay scenario, there are a range of interesting challenges in the form of the Scenario pack, available as free DLC. If you don't find any maps or scenarios you enjoy, you can create your own with the in-game Map Editor, place down entities, enemies, and terrain in any way you like, and even add your own custom script to make for interesting gameplay. Playthrough The idea is that we are going to start with a smaller 100 Science Per Minute (SPM) Base, then move onto our Mid Base which might be about 10k SPM, and then we are going to push the computer to the limit until the frame rate means we can go no further! About the Game If you are not yet playing this game, do check out the developer’s website, they allow you to play a trial for free! check here: [https://factorio.com/download](https://www.youtube.com/redirect?event=video_description&redir_token=QUM4Zm9rVHZJdXNSTXFnbkJ0cnVKdUU1VzBNNnxBR3JiS2FuTmNVMmNoNHAzYjF2UkVtYlpObmpCOXhfRXBKODhLcWJSU3VpMV9NOW1SZXp0OHZVaVl3VmJySU51MDNjZkJqaFJQSTZscmRfc2dxZ1FYMjZuYXVqeExmbDRNc3g1&q=https%3A%2F%2Ffactorio.com%2Fdownload&v=8x8ypodA2DI) Factorio is a fantastic little game created by developers Wube. The whole premise is that you are a space explorer whose recent expedition has gone horribly wrong. You have crash landed on an alien planet and unfortunately your ship did not survive. You now must use your engineering prowess to locate workable resources and build and automate your way to a new spaceship to save yourself! But its not that simple! The more you destroy this planet and construct your life saving structures, the more you are going to anger the locals! You will have to fight them off and balance researching new technology to improve your base against military technology to keep you stronger than the aliens. But the more you pollute the planet, the more they mutate and the stronger they become. Armed only with your own two hands and brain, will you escape the planet or become dinner? Mods This is a Modded Playthrough and the mods I am using are: Factorio: Always Day – This allows you to always see what I am creating. Factorio: Factory Planner – This helps me get ratio’s correct, which is important for UPS in the later game. Factorio: Far Reach – I will ALWAYS forget something!! This helps me get it much easier. Factorio: Nano Bots – Allows for a quicker build time until we get actual bots. Factorio: RSO – This allows different resource patch sizes, so we do not have to keep chopping and changing them. Factorio: Tree Collision – To help me pass through tree easier. Factorio: Vehicle Snap – I don’t yet know what this does but was recommended it by a friend. Praise and thanks Also, a great big thankyou to my inspirations for this series @KatherineOfSky, @Nilaus and @Zisteau! You are awesome! Playthrough The idea is that we are going to start with a smaller 100 Science Per Minute (SPM) Base, then move onto our Mid Base which might be about 10k SPM, and then we are going to push the computer to the limit until the frame rate means we can go no further! About the Game If you are not yet playing this game, do check out the developer’s website, they allow you to play a trial for free! check here: [https://factorio.com/download](https://www.youtube.com/redirect?event=video_description&redir_token=QUM4Zm9rVHZJdXNSTXFnbkJ0cnVKdUU1VzBNNnxBR3JiS2FuTmNVMmNoNHAzYjF2UkVtYlpObmpCOXhfRXBKODhLcWJSU3VpMV9NOW1SZXp0OHZVaVl3VmJySU51MDNjZkJqaFJQSTZscmRfc2dxZ1FYMjZuYXVqeExmbDRNc3g1&q=https%3A%2F%2Ffactorio.com%2Fdownload&v=8x8ypodA2DI) Factorio is a fantastic little game created by developers Wube. The whole premise is that you are a space explorer whose recent expedition has gone horribly wrong. You have crash landed on an alien planet and unfortunately your ship did not survive. You now must use your engineering prowess to locate workable resources and build and automate your way to a new spaceship to save yourself! But its not that simple! The more you destroy this planet and construct your life saving structures, the more you are going to anger the locals! You will have to fight them off and balance researching new technology to improve your base against military technology to keep you stronger than the aliens. But the more you pollute the planet, the more they mutate and the stronger they become. Armed only with your own two hands and brain, will you escape the planet or become dinner? Mods This is a Modded Playthrough and the mods I am using are: Factorio: Always Day – This allows you to always see what I am creating. Factorio: Factory Planner – This helps me get ratio’s correct, which is important for UPS in the later game. Factorio: Far Reach – I will ALWAYS forget something!! This helps me get it much easier. Factorio: Nano Bots – Allows for a quicker build time until we get actual bots. Factorio: RSO – This allows different resource patch sizes, so we do not have to keep chopping and changing them. Factorio: Tree Collision – To help me pass through tree easier. Factorio: Vehicle Snap – I don’t yet know what this does but was recommended it by a friend. After you launch a rocket you start discovering new planets, moons, asteroid belts, and other stars. You build an expansive space station as your main research facility, explore new planets and moons, outpost for special resources, and gradually progress into the darkness of deep space as you expand your interstellar empire. A space Exploration game is long. Early game is characterised with basic sciences on your homeworld and launching a satellite rocket into space. Mid game has you building a research space station, exploring new planets looking for strategic resources, and getting started on the 4 specialist science packs. You have 4 types of specialist science to choose from, your decision can be based solely on the techs you want, but may also be influenced by the strategic resources you have discovered so far. Late game leads you to deep space, expanding an interstellar empire, and working on the complexities of deep space science. Finally you gain the ability to escape the stellar cluster and win the game. WELCOME TO KRASTORIO 2 This Lets Play is exploring the overhaul mod Krastorio 2 created by Krastor and Linver combined with several "drone" mods by Klonan Krastorio 2 Krastorio 2, like it's predecessor, introduces new energy sources, buildings, ores, technologies, turrets, coverings, fuel, ways of producing science, and a major re-balance of many vanilla features. Instead of creating an augmented experience, a total overhaul, or revolutionary new gameplay we wanted to expand upon the vanilla style of the game that we love. To accomplish this we paid special attention to the energy systems and endgame. All of this was accomplished from scratch in order to improve upon the code scturcture and balancing. Drones mods 
*   Construction Drones: An alternative early game construction tech before Robots 
*   Mining Drones: Drones mining materials 
*   Transport Drones: Logistics network as a compliment/alternative to Logistics Robots (Tutorial: [![Image 20](http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JHW4swSqZ0w)•Factorio Mod Tutorial:Transport Drone Tut...](http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FaQMThNH43g))

Instead of creating an augmented experience, a total overhaul, or revolutionary new gameplay we wanted to expand upon the vanilla style of the game that we love. You have to have launched a rocket with satellite first though.
